styleName: C - clean cel-shaded (A0 look) + deblush post-process
styleBlock: STYLE (critical): clean digital editorial illustration, smooth flat cel shading and soft gradients, crisp clean linework, flat vivid but warm color fields, polished vector-like finish, bright and cheerful daylight, adult realistic proportions. Every face has real, expressive eyes with a clearly visible iris and eyebrows; NEVER dot eyes. Skin is smooth, clean and even, one uniform tone: NO freckles, NO spots, NO moles, NO rosy or pink blush, NO coloured or shaded cheek circles; cheeks are the same clean tone as the rest of the face. ABSOLUTELY NO oil painting, NO gouache, NO painterly brushstrokes, NO canvas texture, NO paper grain, NO impasto, NO visible brush marks, NO sketchy pencil texture; smooth and clean only. EVERY person, INCLUDING background and crowd figures, is an adult aged roughly 25 to 55, NEVER elderly, grey-haired, white-haired or bearded elders, NEVER children or teenagers. Landscape composition, absolutely NO text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos.
note: Single source of truth for cover style. scripts/generateCover.ts ALWAYS prepends styleBlock; the model only supplies the scene. REQUIRED post-process: Flux stubbornly adds cheek blush + freckles that prompts do NOT remove; run the deblush step (recolor face skin to the clean forehead tone, keep luminance, median-smooth freckles) on each generated cover before setting it live. Approved reference for style C: cmrrqjdgq000232nvx341oajg-cel-clean (Xochimilco). To change the style, the user approves a new reference and this file is edited (visible in the diff).
